messages:
maria: noticed during daily archive-sanity that a subset of last-night's backup copies landed in the archive bucket without SSE-KMS headers.

satish: how many and which tenants?

maria: ~53 objects across tenant-7 and tenant-42, all from 2026-03-20 rotation window. metadata shows empty x-amz-server-side-encryption fields.

sam: any deploys or config flips around that time?

infra-bot: deploy:blob-rotation v2.3.1 rolled 2026-03-19 02:45 UTC (sha: c4d2f6) by ci/cd

satish: i did an RBAC cleanup last week but blob-rotator-sa still should have kms:Encrypt. i also remember a config MR that set `forward-sse=false` to avoid double-encrypt.

eva: pull CloudTrail for PutObject events in the rotation window and check for KMS Encrypt calls tied to those request IDs.

maria: CloudTrail shows PutObject successes for the keys, but zero corresponding KMS Encrypt events for those request IDs.

sam: client stripped headers during copy. this is a code+process gap not a KMS failure.

maria: immediate plan: 1) pause rotator, 2) move affected objects to quarantine prefix, 3) re-copy from snapshot-store (which has originals) and write with SSE-KMS, 4) run re-encrypt job under ephemeral kms grant, 5) add alerts for PutObject without SSE on backups/*

satish: i'll grant blob-rotator-sa a time-limited kms:Encrypt (ttl=1h) and run a scoped re-encrypt using GenerateDataKey + PutObject with `x-amz-server-side-encryption:aws:kms`. will collect PutObject requestIDs for audit.

eva: i'll add a SIEM rule to alert on PutObject to backups/* where the SSE header is empty and bump CloudTrail object logging to be retained at least 30d for this audit.

sam: i'll revert the config default to preserve SSE, add an integration canary that copies a small test blob and asserts SSE metadata, and block rollout until tests + alert are green.

oncall: prepping a short customer-notification template in case tenants ask; status: likely internal P1 for encops.

infra-bot: created ticket ENCOPS-208765: "archive-copy-missing-sse -> scoped re-encrypt & alerts" assigned satish, eva, sam. due: 2026-03-22

maria: holding rotator rollout until re-encrypt complete and SIEM alert is live. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
